description: This file contains shell script functions for testing a test library, including functions to write, run, and verify tests on test scripts and test outputs.

methods.name: write_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates a test directory and writes a test shell script that sources the test-lib.sh script.

methods.name: _run_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Runs a common procedure to execute a test script with specified parameters and compares the output code.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates a test script and runs it, expecting success (exit code 0).

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Creates a test script and runs it, expecting failure (non-zero exit code).

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Runs the test script expecting success.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Runs the test script expecting failure.

methods.name: _check_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Checks the output of a test script against expected output, comparing stdout and optionally stderr.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Verifies the test output matches expected, expecting success.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Verifies the test output matches expected, expecting an error.
